## Context

This is a scoped follow-up to #1 and the implementation in draft PR #2. The source snapshot is commit `9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8`; it is not a claim that the default branch already contains that work. Coordinate the implementation baseline with PR #2 or its merged successor. Issue creation and the ready-for-agent label do not authorize provider launches, trust/permission changes, audit adoption, billing changes or new spending. Follow the execution host’s current policy and preserve existing evidence.

## Triage evidence

- Fresh current-commit default run reported 7 discovery failures plus 1 each in cache-composition, context-cleanup and context-wrapper before the declared 180-second stop. All observed owned processes settled afterward.
- Do not call this a completed ten-failure suite: other test outcomes were not fully collected. The prior complete serial result is 1,227 passed.

**Redundancy check:** Inspected the test runner configuration, the four failing suites and existing context/cache fixture seams; no cause-specific fix is established. Existing related mechanisms do not satisfy the specific remaining contract below.

**Prior rejection check:** No rejection knowledge base or matching rejection record was present in the inspected checkout. No other follow-up issue existed at triage start.

## Dated source references

- [Default test configuration](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/vitest.config.ts)
- [Discovery regression cases](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/test/pilot/discovery.test.ts)
- [Native cache composition case](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/test/pilot/cache-composition.test.ts)
- [Context cleanup cases](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/test/pilot/context-cleanup.test.ts)
- [Context wrapper integration cases](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/test/pilot/context-wrapper.test.ts)

The agent-brief comment is the implementation contract. Parent #1 stays open until its independent operational acceptance criteria are met.

<!-- council-triage-followup:parallel_tests -->

**Dependencies:** No sibling prerequisite. Runtime and authorization gates in the brief still apply.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** bug
**State:** ready-for-agent, explicitly requested by the maintainer. This means the specification is ready; dependency or runtime gates are not implied to have passed.
**Summary:** Diagnose and fix default parallel test failures

**Current behavior:**
On the pinned revision, a fresh unchanged `npm test` reported ten failures across discovery, cache-composition, context-cleanup and context-wrapper suites before a 180-second triage deadline. This bounded attempt did not finish the whole suite or return a final test exit code. The same revision’s complete serial run passed all 1,227 tests across 67 files. The cause is unproven; a shared-state race or external-provider regression must not be assumed.

**Desired behavior:**
The ordinary offline test command completes reliably under its supported default concurrency, with deterministic fixtures and a demonstrated root-cause correction. Preserve existing behavioral assertions and keep serial results separate from the concurrency regression.

**Key interfaces:**

- Vitest test isolation/lifecycle, `NativeHostInspector`, `QualificationCache` and native-context fixture boundaries.
- Dependency-injected command/RPC/source/time/process seams used by discovery and native wrapper tests.

**Acceptance criteria:**

- [ ] Reproduce the current failure with a bounded default-concurrency run and capture exact revision, environment/concurrency, failing assertions, elapsed phases and cleanup. Preserve partial-run status when a watchdog fires.
- [ ] Isolate and demonstrate the cause with a meaningful failing regression on unchanged production/fixture behavior. Distinguish dependency leakage, shared state, resource contention and timing effects using evidence.
- [ ] Implement the smallest cause-specific correction. Do not serialize the whole suite, broadly raise timeouts, delete/weaken assertions, skip tests or require globally installed providers/credentials as an unexplained workaround.
- [ ] Show the isolated reproduction changes from RED to GREEN and that default `npm test` completes in bounded repeated runs. Record the repetition budget in advance; include a serial control if needed to verify equivalent coverage.
- [ ] All fixture-owned processes, timers, ports, cache locks and temporary resources settle after success, failure and watchdog termination. Do not inspect or kill unrelated sessions.
- [ ] Explain any remaining platform dependency or unavailable reproduction honestly; historical passes and failures are not interchangeable, and a passing isolated run alone does not explain the parallel failure.

**Out of scope:**

- Live model/provider calls, global provider configuration changes and changes to Council voting or launch semantics without causal evidence.
- Unrelated feature work or reclassifying the explicit preflight blockers as test failures.

**Execution and delivery:**
Work against a revision containing the relevant PR #2 implementation. Recheck the current tree and host policy. Supply portable offline coverage and a reviewable change or validation record, with fresh independent review of material work. Required live evidence must use already-authorized, qualified routes and finite declared call/deadline limits. If a required external capability or permission is unavailable, retain a precise blocker and leave operational completion open; do not substitute a diagnostics-only result for the requested behavior. No global settings, accounts, historical artifacts or unrelated work may be changed under this brief.


**Dependencies:** No sibling prerequisite. Runtime and authorization gates in the brief still apply.
